diagnosis: The shared context leaks the outcomes of the two recording checks: S5 states that the relevant safety and information-technology results are recorded before approval. A competent decision-maker can therefore satisfy C7 and C8 without either private fact.
evidence: S5: "the relevant safety and information-technology results are recorded in the activation packet before approval"; this directly supports C7 and C8.
fix_instructions: Rewrite S5 to require that the checks and their results be presented and recorded, without stating or implying that either check has already been completed or recorded.
